summary: Implement automated checkout and payment confirmation flow for PROJ-123

test_scenarios.name: Happy path: Implement automated checkout and payment confirmation flow for PROJ-123
test_scenarios.description: When customer adds items to cart and submits payment, order service must confirm order and log transaction.
preconditions: User is authenticated with valid credentials
test_scenarios.expected_result: System returns 200 OK and updates UI state

test_scenarios.name: Negative: Invalid inputs and validation error
test_scenarios.description: Verify system rejects invalid parameters gracefully
steps: Submit form with empty required fields
test_scenarios.expected_result: System returns 400 Bad Request with RFC 7807 problem details

test_scenarios.name: Edge case: Timeout and network failure recovery
test_scenarios.description: Verify retry and graceful timeout behavior under degraded network
test_scenarios.expected_result: Retry policy executes and succeeds on subsequent attempt
